Meaning:
v. 1. To bring together into a group; to gather.
v. 2. To put or fit together.
Example:
1. At two o'clock we assembled at the door of the museum for a tour.
2. You need only a screwdriver to assemble the bookcase.

Meaning: n. A large meal for many people; a feast.
Example: Fancy foods were served at the banquet, which was given in honor of the teachers who were retiring.

Meaning: n. The load carried by a plane or ship.
Example: The cargo going to Chile was put into containers and loaded onto the boat.

Meaning: n. A barrel-shaped container, especially one for holding liquids.
Example: In the 1800s, ships carried drinking water for the sailors in large casks.

Meaning: v. To honor something in a special way.
Example: Americans celebrate the signing of the Declaration of Independence every Fourth of July.

Meaning: held in; not released or expressed; confined
Example: She let out all of her pent-up anger during the meeting.

Meaning: of or relating to the side
Example: The dancer moved in a lateral direction on stage.

Meaning: the state of being completely ruined or destroyed
Example: The destruction from the storm caused many people to become homeless.

Meaning: the point on the earth's surface directly above the central source of an earthquake
Example: People in Tello were more than 200 miles from the epicenter of the quake.

Meaning: to cause to fall down or fall over
Example: The child built a tower out of blocks and then toppled it.

Meaning: to make something happen
Example: Her joke triggered laughter from all of her classmates.

Meaning: to push something with great force
Example: He thrust his fist into the air.

Meaning: to spread out in waves or rays
Example: Light radiates from the sun.

Meaning: to break or burst open
Example: Her bag ruptured after she tried to stuff too many apples into it.

Meaning: having been revised or changed
Example: The school adopted a modified schedule due to the heat wave.

Meaning: adj. So unreasonable as to be laughable; foolish or silly.
Example: You'd look absurd in a suit and tie at the beach.

Meaning: v. To do something by making an effort; to complete successfully.
Example: I know I will accomplish these errands by noon.

Meaning: v. To rise, usually in a steady way.
Example: The rocket ascended to a height of five hundred feet before falling to Earth.

Meaning:
adj. 1. Tightly packed; crowded close together.
adj. 2. Thick; hard to see through.
adj. 3. Stupid, thickheaded.
Example:
1. The tired explorers hacked their way through dense vines and bushes to reach the coast.
2. At the airport there was such dense fog that planes couldn't take off.
3. I don't want to seem dense, but I don't understand your question.

Meaning:
n. A test to prove or discover something.
v. 1. To carry out experiments.
v. 2. To try out new ideas or activities.
Example:
n. The experiment shows that oxygen and hydrogen combine to form water.
v. 1. Benjamin Franklin experimented with a kite to show that lightning was a form of electricity.
v. 2. A good cook experiments with different herbs and spices to create new dishes.

Meaning:
adj. 1. Easily damaged or broken; not strongly made.
adj. 2. Not believable.
Example:
1. The cart was too flimsy to carry such a heavy load.
2. Saying you lost your pen is a flimsy excuse for not doing your homework.

Meaning:
adj. 1. Very brave; showing great courage.
adj. 2. Showing great determination; requiring enormous effort.
Example:
1. The teenager dove into the pond and made a heroic rescue of the child who couldn't swim.
2. Firefighters made a heroic effort to put out the blaze.

Meaning:
n. Wood that has been sawed into boards.
v. To move in a clumsy or heavy way.
Example:
n. Have you ordered the lumber for the deck you are building?
v. The old dog lumbered toward me.

Meaning:
v. 1. To copy or imitate closely.
v. 2. To make fun of by imitating.
n. One who can imitate sounds, speech, or actions.
Example:
v. 1. The parrot fascinated us because it could mimic human speech so well.
v. 2. I got upset when you mimicked my friend's singing.
n. A good mimic carefully studies the person being imitated.

Meaning: adj. Important; full of meaning.
Example: July 4, 1776, is a significant date in American history.

Meaning:
v. 1. To fly high in the sky.
v. 2. To rise suddenly and rapidly.
Example:
1. We watched the eagles soar until they were just specks in the sky.
2. The cost of a college education is expected to soar during the next few years.

Meaning: n. A person who watches an activity; an onlooker.
Example: The spectators jostled each other as they rushed onto the field at the end of the game.

Meaning:
v. 1. To hang while attached to something above.
v. 2. To stop for a while before going on.
v. 3. To bar from working, attending, or taking part for a while.
Example:
1. The hammock was suspended from the porch ceiling.
2. The subway suspended its main route for two days while the track was repaired.
3. The students caught cheating were suspended from school for one week.

Meaning: v. To bring or to come to an end.
Example: Heavy rain terminated the tennis match after only ten minutes of play.

Meaning: adj. Hard to handle or control because of large size or heaviness.
Example: The sofa was so unwieldy that getting it up three flights of stairs was a real challenge.
